entities.summary: Warrick Stock, better known as DJ Warras, was a South African DJ, radio and television presenter, podcaster and businessman. He hosted youth-oriented radio shows on stations such as YFM and 5FM, and became well known as a presenter on SABC1’s music show Live AMP. In 2025, he was the host of the Mzansi Magic reality series Ngicel’iVisa. He also co-hosted the popular online Shady PHodcast.
